name: pmfby_calculate_premium
description: Calculates the estimated insurance premium payable by a farmer for a specific crop, season, and insured area under PMFBY. This helps farmers understand their contribution before applying. Prerequisites: None. It does NOT submit an insurance application or provide claim-related information.

crop_name.description: Name of the crop to insure, e.g. wheat, paddy, cotton

season.description: Crop season. Kharif = June-October (paddy, cotton, maize). Rabi = November-April (wheat, mustard, gram). Zaid = April-June (watermelon, cucumber, fodder crops).

area_hectare.description: Area of land in hectares for which insurance is required

name: pmfby_check_application_status
description: Checks the status of an existing PMFBY insurance application using the application reference number. Prerequisites: pmfby_submit_application must have been called earlier. It does NOT check claim status or provide payment/claim settlement details.

application_id.description: Unique application reference number generated during enrollment

season.description: Crop season. Kharif = June-October (paddy, cotton, maize). Rabi = November-April (wheat, mustard, gram). Zaid = April-June (watermelon, cucumber, fodder crops).

name: pmfby_check_claim_status
description: Retrieves the status of a submitted crop loss/damage claim under PMFBY. Prerequisites: pmfby_submit_claim must have been completed earlier. It does NOT check application/enrollment status or calculate premiums.

claim_id.description: Unique claim reference number generated during claim submission

name: pmfby_submit_application
description: Submits a new crop insurance application for a farmer under PMFBY. This enrolls the farmer for insurance coverage for a specific crop and season. Prerequisites: None, but premium details are typically calculated beforehand. It does NOT submit crop loss claims or check application status.

farmer_name.description: Full name of the farmer applying for insurance

crop_name.description: Name of the crop to insure

season.description: Crop season. Kharif = June-October (paddy, cotton, maize). Rabi = November-April (wheat, mustard, gram). Zaid = April-June (watermelon, cucumber, fodder crops).

name: pmfby_submit_claim
description: Submits a crop loss or damage claim under PMFBY for an insured crop. Prerequisites: pmfby_submit_application must have been completed and the crop must be insured. It does NOT check claim status or process claim settlement.

application_id.description: Application ID of the insured crop

loss_date.description: Date on which crop loss occurred

season.description: Crop season. Kharif = June-October (paddy, cotton, maize). Rabi = November-April (wheat, mustard, gram). Zaid = April-June (watermelon, cucumber, fodder crops).

name: pmfby_find_enrollment_center
description: Finds the nearest Common Service Center (CSC) or bank branch where a farmer can enroll for PMFBY insurance. Prerequisites: None. It does NOT submit applications or provide insurance details.

district.description: District where the farmer is located

state.description: State where the farmer is located

name: pmfby_get_crop_coverage_details
description: Provides crop-wise insurance coverage details including sum insured and risk coverage under PMFBY. Prerequisites: None. It does NOT calculate premium or submit applications.

season.description: Crop season. Kharif = June-October (paddy, cotton, maize). Rabi = November-April (wheat, mustard, gram). Zaid = April-June (watermelon, cucumber, fodder crops).

name: pmfby_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance related to claim rejection, delay, or other PMFBY service issues. Prerequisites: A claim or application must already exist. It does NOT track grievance status or resolve the issue.

reference_id.description: Application ID or Claim ID related to the grievance

name: pmfby_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks the current status of a previously raised grievance under PMFBY. Prerequisites: pmfby_raise_grievance must have been called earlier. It does NOT raise new grievances or provide claim details.

name: pmfby_get_notified_crops
description: Retrieves the list of government-notified crops eligible for insurance in a specific district and season under PMFBY. Prerequisites: None. It does NOT provide premium calculation or coverage details.

season.description: Crop season. Kharif = June-October (paddy, cotton, maize). Rabi = November-April (wheat, mustard, gram). Zaid = April-June (watermelon, cucumber, fodder crops).
